paragraphs.text: Myra the Magnificent is a human performer and the founder of Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun .

Myra is ambitious and will do whatever is needed to get it done, whether she needs to take shortcuts or not. Excitement is her top priority, while safety is her twelfth. Nonetheless, she cares about all of her employees, and is very good to them.

Myra had really big dreams from a young age. Her goal was to make a spectacular park and a multiversal spectacle. She inherited a giant, dilapidated space station and saw her chance to leave a mark on the universe. The Astrotorium was founded "a tactically unspecified number of years ago" when Myra launched a roller coaster into space.
